subject: general
question: _______ is an Indian Technology developed by Research Design and Standards Organisation in collaboration with Indian Railways in March 2022, that can prevent two trains from colliding.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kavach.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kavach:**

 
 
• It** **is an** advanced technology **that can** prevent train collisions** by **detecting the presence of another train **on the same track and **automatically applying brakes **to avoid a collision.
 
• It is based on a combination of** sensors, communication systems, and artificial intelligence algorithms** that can analyze and predict the movement of trains in real-time.
 
• It has been developed by the **Research Design and Standards Organisation (RDSO)** in collaboration with **Indian Railways** and was launched in **March 2022.**
 
• The technology is expected to significantly improve the** safety and efficiency** of train operations in India, which has one of the** largest railway networks** in the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Research Designs & Standards Organisation** (RDSO):

 
 
• It is the research and development organisation.
 
• It works under the **Ministry of Railways** of the Government of India.
 
• In **1957,** it was founded.
 
• Its headquarters is in **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. **
 
 
 
• **Trishool:**
 
 
• It is a **short-range, low-level, quick-reaction surface-to-air missile.**
 
• As a component of the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme (IGMDP), it is being **developed in India by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO). **
 
• **1983 saw the launch of the Trishul missile project **as a component of the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme.
 
• It can also be deployed as an anti-sea skimmer from a navy vessel to thwart aeroplanes, assault helicopters, and low-flying missiles.
